issue.title: bob-cli clippy denies unconditional || true in pomodoro_name.rs
issue.description:
bob-cli `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features` (and therefore `just all`) fails on origin/master `f7c268dc6497ca0e739f908d41e144299507bc05` at tests/cli/capture/pomodoro_name.rs:808.

The assertion is:

```rust
assert!(
    stdout(&output).contains("declares dependencies")
        || format!("{json}").contains("dependsOn")
        || json["warnings"].is_null()
        || true
);
```

`|| true` makes the condition unconditional. Blame is 7d1c8dd3 (2026-09-28), which is an ancestor of current origin/master, so this predates the listen-card epic sase-1g6. The same line is what stopped `just all` for phases sase-1g6.2, sase-1g6.3, and sase-1g6.4. It is not intermittent: the source itself is the lint failure.

Fix the assertion so it checks the real schedule/dependency outcome, and drop the tautology, without changing listen-card behavior.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The failure is the source line `|| true` in tests/cli/capture/pomodoro_name.rs:808. Clippy denies that unconditional boolean on every run. It is present on origin/master f7c268dc6497ca0e739f908d41e144299507bc05 and on ancestor 7d1c8dd3 from 2026-09-28. A rerun cannot pass while that line remains.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1g6 phase agents could not finish bob-cli `just all` because clippy denies a tautological assertion that has been on origin since 2026-09-28, and no task bead tracks it.
